recordBasis: Most recent 300 committed data/candidates consideration rows, retaining repeat assessments across runs; no first/repair double counting.
method: Conservative declared-buyer audit using the provisional profit reason only. This is not verified customer demand. No customer is inferred solely from a tool title, source domain or developer-media listing. Ambiguous and absent buyers are unknown.

publishedMix.basis: Existing whoPays hypotheses; seven historical posts, no demand-first backfill.
